extracted.description: Quantify the monotonic association between the abundance of protein PLK1 and the abundance of CHEK2-S163 in tumor samples using the Spearman rank correlation coefficient.
The analysis population is restricted to tumor samples that belong to the study.
Samples with missing abundance values for either PLK1 or CHEK2-S163 must be excluded before computing the correlation.
The final reported Spearman correlation must be presented as a single numeric value rounded to 4 decimal places.

stored.description: Quantify the monotonic association between the abundance of protein PLK1 and the abundance of CHEK2-S163 in tumor samples using the Spearman rank correlation coefficient.
acceptanceCriteria: The reported number is the Spearman rank correlation coefficient between PLK1 abundance and CHEK2-S163 abundance.
The correlation is computed on paired observations where both abundance values are present (pairwise complete observations).
Exactly one correlation value is produced for the specified sample population.
